description: Profile one saved segment on its own, without any audience set logic or exclusions. Returns a BigQuery-computed demographic breakdown (age buckets, geography, and a behavioral/financial extra when available) evaluated directly over the segment's own definition — the segment-level path, with no audience composition (set_logic/exclusions) applied. Works for any subtype (filter, matched, custom) — non-filter subtypes resolve via the same underlying ID-set composition audiences use. Results may populate a 20-minute server-side cache and record query telemetry; the segment definition is unchanged. Requires 'discovery' scope.
